task_instance: Apply a gating strategy (GatingML 2.0) to a sample flow-cytometry FCS file using the flowkit skill's analyze_gates.py helper (or the Python GatingStrategy/Session API) to produce the skill's core deliverable: gate_report.csv with per-population counts, absolute_percent, relative_percent, full population_path and denominators, plus provenance.json.
blocker_detail: The skill's core deliverable requires executing Python with the FlowKit 1.3.2 package (installed into a fresh virtual environment, compiling FlowUtils if needed) to parse binary FCS event data, apply spillover compensation and logicle/biexponential transforms, run hierarchical gating, and emit gate_report.csv / provenance.json. The office-assistant runtime grants only reading/writing/editing of text files; it cannot run code or shell commands, cannot install packages, and cannot read or produce binary files. The required inputs themselves (FCS files) are binary and cannot be created as text either, and the deliverable is produced only by the executed analysis, not by writing text. No amount of text editing can perform the numerical gating computation, so the core intent cannot be exercised in this runtime.
evidence: Read the skill document (SKILL.md). Its Install, 'Apply an existing strategy', and 'Build a strategy in Python' sections all require running Python/uv with flowkit==1.3.2 (e.g. 'uv run ... python scripts/analyze_gates.py --gatingml gates.xml --fcs sample.fcs --output-dir results-gatingml'), which parses binary FCS data and writes gate_report.csv and provenance.json. The runtime forbids running any code or shell command and cannot create or read binary FCS files, so the gating computation and its CSV/JSON outputs cannot be produced or verified. No deliverable file was generated beyond this result.json in the work directory.
